FIFA World Cup 2026 Enters Knockout Stage with Multiple Matchups

The FIFA World Cup 2026 has advanced to its Round of 32, marking the beginning of the knockout stage where each match is a win-or-go-home contest. Several teams, including Morocco, Ivory Coast, Norway, Netherlands, Mexico, and Ecuador, are preparing for their upcoming fixtures. Fan activities and team preparations are being highlighted as the tournament progresses towards determining the ultimate champion.
